name: grafana-mcp
description: MCP server for AI-assisted Grafana dashboard, datasource, alerting, and incident management.

grafana_url.title: Grafana instance URL
grafana_url.description: Your Grafana instance URL. For Grafana Cloud: https://<stack>.grafana.net. For self-hosted: e.g. http://localhost:3000.

grafana_service_account_token.title: Grafana service account token
grafana_service_account_token.description: Create a service account token at <your-grafana-url>/org/serviceaccounts with at least Viewer role (Editor for write operations).
